mass.reference: About 5 g a motor, from teardowns of similar sub-250 g drones

thrust.reference: About 160 g of thrust a motor at full throttle on 2S, enough for the published 5 m/s climb

current.reference: Full-throttle draw a motor on 2S; DJI doesn't publish it

efficiency.reference: Rotor figure of merit of about 0.6 times about 0.65 for motor and ESC, typical of small brushless drives
